cns.text: Paliano is forged by the Charter that Brago and Selvala draft together, but the story opens on its ruin, with a withered King Brago kept alive by the Custodi's treatments until he begs Selvala to kill him.
Selvala forgives him and stabs him through the heart, but the Custodi plan to keep their power and Brago's spirit orders them to announce that the king has risen, and they hail him as King Eternal.

Elsewhere in the city's intrigue, Ervos Trax poisons himself over dinner in Marchesa's mansion so that she will be blamed for his death, and Muzzio's hidden constructs ruin Professor Emralla, Tulando and Chancellor Grinaldi.

cn2.text: In Conspiracy: Take the Crown, Paliano gets a queen when Kaya, paid by Marchesa, drives a dagger into the ghost of King Brago while Adriana stands guard, and his form dissolves.
The Custodi crown Marchesa Queen of Paliano the next day, and she says they accepted a legal will naming her heir after she dealt with Brago's descendants.
Adriana refuses the black-rose breastplate and spits in Marchesa's face, then tells the citizens she will not give up her duty to defend the city from the usurper.
Months later she visits Selvala and asks her to help build the Republic of Paliano.
